lines.text: The disciples ask who is greatest, and Jesus has a child stand among them saying the humble are greatest.
Jesus says better a large millstone around his neck, drowned in the sea, than making a little one stumble.
A man with a hundred sheep leaves the ninety-nine on the hills to search for the one that is lost.
Confront a sinning brother privately; if he refuses, take one or two others; if he still refuses, tell the priests.
Jesus says if two of you agree about anything you ask, it will be done by the angels in heaven.
